Version 13.0.0 of Landing Experience Checker introduces an in-depth skill contract and clarifies usage for pre-launch landing page checks:

- Adds full skill documentation in SKILL.md, detailing checks for message-match, above-the-fold offer/CTA, page speed, form-field friction, and mobile rendering.
- Explains the role: strictly flags and routes landing page experience gaps; does not rewrite/design pages or calculate Quality Score—redirects those tasks to sibling skills.
- Outlines precise contract for expected input (e.g., ad copy, offer, goals, page, and possible speed data) and output (pass/fix punch list, reusable handoff summary).
- Specifies stepwise instructions and data sources, including keyless rendered-page reading and PageSpeed integration.
- Reinforces security by treating all page and ad content as untrusted input.
- Clarifies next-steps routing for each identified issue, ensuring clear handoff to responsible sibling skills.
